4279-4699-4976--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4699-4976--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-7316--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-7316--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Rat King triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

2178-3362-6542-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
2178-3362-6542-8095.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

147-3899-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-3899-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

640-1981-2415-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

5078-6556-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1991-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-3259-4742.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1580-2921-4871-6248.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2510-3532-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
2510-3532-5078-6792.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3532-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

1368-3755-6321-6633.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-6321-6633.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-7358.easyPrerequisites: You don't control a Devil token.
3259-5434-7358.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7358.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.
Maestros Diabolist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-1115-2438-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

2438-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2438-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

64-372-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2700-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4772-6965.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1018-4067-6281-6893.notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
1018-4067-6281-6893.description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty {U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Skullwinder.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Skullwinder that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Skullwinder token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.

2034-2820-3499-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

1374-3626-4785-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-4785-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

565-1858-5645--118.notablePrerequisites: You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
565-1858-5645--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar triggers, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-5043-5078-5231.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {R}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

1-5435-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-5435-5796-6282.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2457-4068-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1270-2457-4068-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2493-2781-4617-4906-6084.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You have not activated Soulbright Flamekin's ability more than twice this turn.
2493-2781-4617-4906-6084.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Felidar Guardian's trigger, targeting each other creature you control except Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the copies of Felidar Guardian's trigger targeting Soulbright Flamekin and Archaeomancer, blinking Soulbright Flamekin and Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Deflecting Swat from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Deflecting Swat by paying {0}, changing any of the remaining Felidar Guardian triggers not targeting Agrus Kos to target Agrus Kos instead.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

2438-3305-4022-4772-5926.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.

1461-2842-4050-4078.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {B}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine trigger, creating two 3/3 Wurm artifact creature tokens.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Wurm tokens, adding {B}{B}.
When the Wurms die, Blood Artist trigger twice, causing you to gain 2 life and an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, putting Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

4908-4970-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
4908-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2335-2838-2979.notablePrerequisites: Patchwork Crawler does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2335-2838-2979.description:
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Soul Diviner's ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

877-1899-2232-2459.description:
Activate Beastcaller Savant by tapping it, adding {G} that can only be spent to cast a creature spell.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Beastcaller Savant to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Beastcaller Savant by paying {1} due to Morophon.
When Beastcaller Savant enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

1651-1737-4365-4715.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Prized Statue.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures and/or Prized Statue tokens, untapping Prototype Portal.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2034-2577-4758.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

985-2034-2471-4574.notablePrerequisites: Zabaz has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
985-2034-2471-4574.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Zabaz, adding {C}{C}.
Zabaz dies, triggering its modular ability, moving its +1/+1 counters onto Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Zabaz on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Zabaz from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Zabaz enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

2-1636-2502.notablePrerequisites:
Jhoira does not have summoning sickness.
Jhoira has at least two ingenuity counters on it.
2-1636-2502.description:
Activate Jhoira by tapping it, putting two ingenuity counters on it and putting Ancestral Statue from your hand onto the battlefield.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1283-2397-3277-4615-4739.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two other creatures.
1283-2397-3277-4615-4739.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {2}, adding {1} for each creature you control.
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {3}, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch.
The Izzet Chronarch token enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning Battle Hymn and Quasiduplicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may return any other instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard in place of Battle Hymn.

165-2440-3263.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Spirits.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-2440-3263.description:
Activate Daxos by paying {3}, creating a Spirit enchantment creature token with power and toughness equal to the number of experience counters you have.
The Spirit entering the battlefield  triggers Mana Echoes, adding at least {3}.
Repeat.

328-3260-4078-5256.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 10 or greater.
You have at least two opponents, or your devotion to black is at least ten.
328-3260-4078-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
Activate Chainer by paying 9 life due to K'rrik, returning Gray Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Nightmare in addition to its other creature types.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Repeat.
328-3260-4078-5256.notes: The additional gained life can be used by Chainer to return all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
